basics.name: EJ Fox
basics.label: Design Engineer & Creative Technologist
basics.summary: Design engineer and creative technologist who does good work under pressure. I turn complicated information into interactive graphics people can actually read, and I have fun doing it. The work mixes journalistic curiosity with an addiction to trying new things. That has included NBC’s election-night graphics and experimental interfaces for embeddings. I want to make things no one has seen before, with smart, kind people.

work.name: Arizona State University NEWSWELL
work.summary: The Lenfest Institute’s AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program, hosted at ASU and supported by OpenAI and Microsoft
highlights: Built a tool that uses AI to lay out the ads and stories in hyperlocal print newspapers
Gave an Ignite talk on it at ASU’s National Journalism + AI Accelerator in January 2026
Demoed it to OpenAI, Microsoft, ProPublica and the Boston Globe on the program’s demo day

work.name: Independent Consultant
work.summary: Select Clients: GitHub • NBC News • CBS News • Washington Post • New York Times • Carnegie Mellon • Stamen
highlights: I specialize in tight deadlines, short sprints with user testing along the way, and above all the things no one has done before.
For CBS News, helped prototype their broadcast touchscreen app. For the New York Times, an analysis of newspaper front pages. With the geniuses at Stamen, geographic visualizations.
I sit between the design and engineering teams and work in whatever stack the client already has, whether that is a brand-new startup or a big enterprise with its own process.
I work in public whenever I can. That means 50+ Observable notebooks, plus YouTube livestreams and blog posts about work in progress, experiments and how I do things.

Helped the Wildlife Conservation Society map and tell the story of coral reefs that are resisting climate change
